## Fixed

- **Themed icons cover the remaining apps.** Apps with an old-style icon, and icons from an icon pack, were skipped and kept their colours. They are now themed like the rest. Icons are rebuilt once after this update.
- **Closing a folder keeps its icons inside the shape.** With "keep icons inside the folder shape" on, the icons still poked past the edge for a moment while the folder closed. They are now cut to the shape during the whole animation.
